command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,sys,re
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/expanded-corpus-r536/'
plan={"url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2405.04119","routes":["363002"],"destination":"sources/2405.04119.pdf","source_identity":"Havet Horsch Rambaud Diameter of the inversion graph arXiv 2405.04119","purpose":"Read actual source definition, bounds and conjecture for the unlabelled inversion diameter of complete graphs, target 363002"}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',L+'write_lane.py','plans/get_2405_04119.json'],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1),text=True,capture_output=True)
print('WRITE',r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
if r.returncode: sys.exit(r.returncode)
g=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',L+'source_get_guard.py',L+'plans/get_2405_04119.json'],text=True,capture_output=True)
print('GUARD',g.returncode); print(g.stdout); print(g.stderr[-1500:])
if g.returncode: sys.exit(g.returncode)
o=subprocess.run(['pdftotext',L+'sources/2405.04119.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True)
t=o.stdout
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',L+'write_lane.py','sources/2405.04119.txt'],input=t,text=True,capture_output=True)
print('PDF',o.returncode,'WRITE',w.returncode,'LEN',len(t))
hits=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'[Uu]nlabelled|mathcal\{U\}|U\(K',t)]
print(len(hits),hits[:20])
last=-5000;n=0
for h in hits:
    if h-last>1800 and n<5:
        print('@',h,t[max(0,h-500):h+1300].replace('\n',' '));print('---');last=h;n+=1
sys.exit(o.returncode or w.returncode)
